design_choices: Phase 0 complete: instrumentation only; no numerical algorithm, threshold, dispatch, default or optimization switch change.

Real-Gamma projection, rank reduction, coupling, back product, image addition and scalar energy audit are timed/counted under PHASE_PROFILE. STAGE_TIMERS=off preserves counts with zero lane clocks. Disabled spans have no clocks, TLS/counter arithmetic, allocation, locks or I/O; only the enable branch remains.

Thread-local snapshots feed an isolated NonlocalMark section in engine profile.rs. Existing CLI serialization exports additive nonlocal.* fields per phase bucket and rank extrema. No CLI production serializer or stage_clock edit.

FLOP and logical-byte inputs plus projection-width bins are diagnostic work models, not measured memory traffic. Empty products are omitted. Scalar audit FLOPs reflect the existing serial sparse-zero skip versus distributed dense contraction.
The parser distinguishes zero-call stages as unusable, provides bounded per-call/per-map bucket averages, and omits timing fields entirely in Mac mode.
Orchestrator approved real_gamma.rs and profile.rs for wiring. Stop now; Phase 2 requires returned dev08 data.

numerical_outputs: 6/6 actual CLI runs converge and verify: Si8 and Si32, off/counts-only/timed. Four off/on pairs have bit-identical scientific f64 values, eigenvalues, occupations, history, work, verification attempts and density bytes; max |dE| = 0 Ha.
Si8 energy -31.321776563202498 Ha, 11 fine iterations; Si32 energy -126.70343204998852 Ha, 10 fine iterations. Complete density and scientific SHA-256 values in equivalence.json.
Four actual-file parser validations; 48 bucket/stage rows each. Five parser tests pass, including the retained unmodified Mac CLI JSON fixture.
Counts-only lane seconds are 0 s; timed/counts-only counters agree. No Mac timing is used to support a performance conclusion.
Two simulated ranks: identical energy bits, density FNV and SCF/Davidson/H work off/on; coarse/fine/verification projection and rank-reduction counters populated.
Final fast gate: 480 passed, 3 failed, 131 ignored. Build/fmt/clippy pass; three known CLI cache restrictions under in-repository TMPDIR cause exit 1.
Earlier independent synthetic checks: 45 operator/energy pairs bit-identical (0 Ha difference), 11 distributed integration tests passed.
reference_comparison: Same-binary instrumentation off/counts-only/timed comparisons only. No new QE run/reference or dev08 profile. Exact JSON paths and separate same-model dev08 jobs are in profile-request.md.
limitations: Real MPI/MKL execution and performance profiling remain for dev08; simulated ranks are correctness evidence only.
The collection is qualified for one worker per rank and one core. Multiworker/HAPPLY_OVERLAP pool-thread attribution is not implemented.
Rank extrema and bounded bucket averages are not individual-call, individual-map or rank-ID traces. Do not divide maxima from different ranks as if they were one rank.
This real-Gamma application profile excludes complex k-point kernels, projector construction and the copy of externally cached projections. Child timer sums are not a complete H-apply wall budget.

The required fast gate remains nonzero due to three known CLI pseudopotential cache tests rejecting in-repository TMPDIR. No tolerance, cache rule or path restriction was relaxed. Sandbox also denies optional ps/nice diagnostics.
Dashboard/session updates remain the orchestrator responsibility; source and artifacts are uncommitted.
